strategy.thesis: One of Japan's leading VC firms and the asset-management core of the SBI Group; pioneered Japan's first dedicated FinTech fund in 2015 (JPY 30bn) and a follow-on AI & Blockchain fund (JPY 60bn), investing in promising FinTech, AI and blockchain startups in Japan and overseas.

summary.en: SBI Investment is the venture-capital and asset-management arm of Japan's SBI Group, founded in 1996 and headquartered in Tokyo. In December 2015 it launched Japan's first dedicated FinTech fund (JPY 30bn 'FinTech Fund'), followed in 2018 by the JPY 60bn 'SBI AI & Blockchain Fund', making it one of the most active fintech-focused investors in the country.
summary.local: SBIグループの中核VC・資産運用会社。2015年12月に総額300億円の「FinTechファンド」、2018年に総額600億円の「SBI AI&Blockchainファンド」を組成し、日本のフィンテック投資をリードする。

summary.en: GMO VenturePartners, founded in 2005, is the venture-capital arm of Japan's GMO Internet Group and one of the country's most FinTech-focused investors. It runs successive dedicated fintech vehicles (GMO Global FinTech Fund, 2018; GMO Fintech Fund 8, 2026) and has built a 200+ company portfolio with around 20 IPOs across Japan, the US, India and Southeast Asia.

strategy.thesis: The corporate venture-capital arm of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, consolidating FinTech investments previously handled separately across the group. Its thesis is primarily centered on fintech but also spans AI, blockchain, data analytics, cybersecurity and regtech critical to the future of finance.

summary.en: MUFG Innovation Partners (MUIP), established January 2019, is the corporate VC arm of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group and one of Japan's most fintech-focused investors. Its first fund launched at JPY 20bn (USD 180m), followed by ~JPY 30bn and JPY 20bn funds, with total AUM around JPY 80bn and 50+ active portfolio companies, primarily in fintech and adjacent technologies.
summary.local: 三菱UFJフィナンシャル・グループのCVC。2019年1月設立。グループ内に分散していたフィンテック投資を集約し、フィンテックを中心にAI・ブロックチェーン・サイバーセキュリティ等へ投資。

aka: 東京フィンテックセンター

strategy.thesis: Japan's first and largest FinTech incubation/acceleration hub, based in Otemachi, Tokyo. In September 2020 it established the FINOLAB FUND (JPY 500m) to back seed-to-early-stage fintech startups, pairing capital with a dedicated acceleration team and the financial-industry network of its founders.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via FINOLAB website / membership community

summary.en: FINOLAB (The FinTech Center of Tokyo) is Japan's first dedicated fintech hub, established in February 2016 by Mitsubishi Estate, Dentsu and DCS in Otemachi. In September 2020 it launched the JPY 500 million FINOLAB FUND to invest in seed-to-early-stage fintech startups, and was selected to operate the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's 'Fintech Support Fund'.
summary.local: 日本初のフィンテック拠点「東京フィンテックセンター」。2016年2月設立。2020年9月に総額5億円の「FINOLAB FUND」を組成し、シード～アーリーのフィンテック・スタートアップへ投資。東京都の『フィンテック支援ファンド』運営事業者にも採択。

strategy.thesis: The venture arm of Credit Saison, one of Japan's largest consumer-credit companies. It invests in seed-to-Series-A fintech founders building platforms that distribute financial services to the underbanked across Southeast Asia and India, and since 2021 has expanded into blockchain/RWA fintech via the Onigiri Capital fund (stablecoins, payments, asset tokenization, DeFi, financial infrastructure).

summary.en: Saison Capital is the Singapore-based corporate venture arm of Japan's Credit Saison, established in 2019 to back fintech startups across Southeast Asia and India, with a focus on distributing financial services to the underbanked. In 2025 it launched Onigiri Capital, a USD 50m fund targeting blockchain/RWA fintech (stablecoins, payments, tokenization, DeFi, financial infrastructure).
